## About
Help Squad is a general contractor working out of San Vicente Blvd in Los Angeles. We take on renovations, fixes after bigger projects, and the smaller installs that are hard to do yourself.
One customer had us fix walls, floors and a ceiling after a furnace replacement. Another had us close up drywall and put in a new shower system after an old shower leaked in the wall. We also help with things like setting up a desk and a heavy monitor in an office.
We're open Monday through Saturday. Give us a call and tell us what you need.

## Services
- Renovation projects: One building owner said we treated their renovation project as if it was our own home.
- Wall, floor and ceiling work: Fixing walls, wood floors and ceilings after other work, like a furnace replacement, opens things up.
- Shower and drywall work: Installing a new shower system and replacing drywall with wonder board where an old shower has leaked in the wall.
